# The names that look like a path into this repository and are not one.
#
# One `<name> <reason>` per line. TestEveryNamedRepoPathExists checks this list in BOTH
# directions: a name that is missing from the tree and not listed here is a red run, and a
# name listed here that nothing writes any more is a stale entry and also a red run. So the
# list only ever gets shorter, and a row parks nothing.
#
# There are only two honest reasons to be here: the name is an INVENTED example (a
# specification showing the shape of a path), or the name is written down so a test can
# prove the existence check answers no.

cmd/nova-foo the invented tool docs/SPEC-*.md use to show the shape of a command's path; there is no such tool and there must not be
internal/ci/no-such-file.go a name TestTheNamedPathExistenceCheckReadsTheTree requires to be absent, so a check that answered yes to everything could not pass
internal/ci/doc.go/ the same, as a directory: a real file named with a trailing slash must still read as absent
